constraint.description: spring.jpa.open-in-view=true keeps a database connection open during view rendering: disable it.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (f:Yaml:File)-[:HAS_DOCUMENT]->(:Yaml:Document)-[:HAS_MAP]->(:Yaml:Map)-[:HAS_KEY]->(:Yaml:Key {name: 'spring'})-[:HAS_VALUE]->(:Yaml:Map)-[:HAS_KEY]->(:Yaml:Key {name: 'jpa'})-[:HAS_VALUE]->(:Yaml:Map)-[:HAS_KEY]->(k:Yaml:Key {name: 'open-in-view'})-[:HAS_VALUE]->(v:Yaml:Scalar) WHERE toLower(toString(v.value)) = 'true' RETURN f AS Element, f.fileName AS Fqn, 'spring.jpa.open-in-view: true' AS Detail

constraint.description: spring.datasource.hikari.maximum-pool-size above the parameter maxHikariPoolSize overcommits the database.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (f:Yaml:File)-[:HAS_DOCUMENT]->(:Yaml:Document)-[:HAS_MAP]->(:Yaml:Map)-[:HAS_KEY]->(:Yaml:Key {name: 'spring'})-[:HAS_VALUE]->(:Yaml:Map)-[:HAS_KEY]->(:Yaml:Key {name: 'datasource'})-[:HAS_VALUE]->(:Yaml:Map)-[:HAS_KEY]->(:Yaml:Key {name: 'hikari'})-[:HAS_VALUE]->(:Yaml:Map)-[:HAS_KEY]->(k:Yaml:Key {name: 'maximum-pool-size'})-[:HAS_VALUE]->(v:Yaml:Scalar) WHERE v.value =~ '[0-9]+' AND toInteger(v.value) > toInteger($maxHikariPoolSize) RETURN f AS Element, f.fileName AS Fqn, 'maximum-pool-size: ' + v.value AS Detail
